from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u017/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8b589275.py')
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != background]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] == background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
